text:
olivia: Hey team — quick heads up: we just cut a community release for the Contributors Bundle v0.2.0. lightweight utilities for onboarding and maintainer workflows. changelog + assets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-contribs/releases/tag/v0.2.0 :tada:
hiro: amazing, congrats! what's the recommended install path for integrators?
sam: install is just pip for the python helpers and npm for the frontend bits. short: `pip install redwood-contribs==0.2.0` and `npm i @redwood-inference/contribs@0.2.0`
olivia: exact — we added a tiny shim to detect redwoodctl config and a `redwood-contribs config migrate` command for teams upgrading from older templates. example:
```
# migrate config from legacy templates
redwood-contribs config migrate --from legacy --yes
```
hiro: nice. any breaking changes?
oli via dev-bot: dev-bot: release workflow succeeded for tag v0.2.0 (build 482) :white_check_mark:
sam: API surface is backwards compatible, but we removed the legacy `get-metrics` subcommand (moved to telemetry-plugin). updater prints a deprecation notice if you still call it.
tess: will update the starter templates in the docs site — fyi I'll submit PRs to the example apps repo tomorrow.
olivia: thanks! also calling out two new features for maintainers: 1) interactive changelog generator (`contribs changelog new`) and 2) a small PR-labeler hook that recommends reviewers based on modified modules. both opt-in.
hiro: can we get a point person for community questions? I'll ping the community slack channel and the GH discussions.
olivia: tagging sam as point person for the next 48h, i'm around for eskalations.
sam: happy to help — will monitor the release thread and the discussions.
tess: can we add a one-line blurb for marketing to use?
olivia: sure — "New: Contributors Bundle v0.2.0 — faster onboarding, lighter maintainer workflows, and opt-in automation for repo hygiene. See release notes for details."
hiro: more test coverage on the CI would be great. opened an issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-contribs/issues/87
olivia: noted — thanks. feel free to triage, i'll add priority label.
dev-bot: deploy-bot: docs site build succeeded for branch release/v0.2.0 :rocket:
sam: thanks everyone. I'll post a short announcement to the community newsletter and pin the release notes in #community-updates. :thumbsup:
olivia: closing thread — if you see anything odd (install failures, regressions) ping me or sam directly. :wave:
